title: A quasi-excellent ring is Nagata
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma deduces the Nagata property from quasi-excellence. The proof uses that finite type algebras over a quasi-excellent ring are quasi-excellent to reduce to showing that a quasi-excellent domain is universally Japanese, then reduces further, using the characterisation of that property together with the J-2 property of quasi-excellent rings, to the case of a quasi-excellent local domain. There the regularity of the completion map makes the completion reduced, which says exactly that the ring is analytically unramified, and the standard criterion then gives the universal Japanese property.
